# Forge-generated visual evidence

These PNG files are deterministic outputs of `@ludivra/visual-authoring` generator
version 4. They are not authoring inputs and contain no imported visual content.

Regenerate them from:

- `../visuals/goblin-shaman-production.character.json`
- `../styles/stylized/style.yaml`
- `../visuals/indie-mechanic-mascot.character.json`
- `../styles/mascot/style.yaml`

with:

```bash
game visual compile visual.goblin.shaman.production --project <fixture-project> --force
game visual compile visual.mascot.mechanic.production --project <fixture-project> --force
```

Each 2D image is the declared three-quarter camera. Each 2.5D image contains
the eight ordered camera directions rendered from the same canonical mesh.
The mascot is the `hero-mascot` first-pass profile evidence: no imported mesh,
texture, image or visual reference is consumed by its recipe.
